events.title: Cinderpeak Compute matches Halcyon's price cut within 48 hours
events.takeaway: The pass-through became a price war: Cinderpeak matched without claiming any cost decline.
events.what_changed: Cinderpeak Compute cut its standard tier to $1.45, five cents below Halcyon, and gave no cost figures.
data_points: Cinderpeak standard tier: $2.40 to **$1.45** per million tokens, effective immediately
Cinderpeak's fleet is on average 14 months older than Halcyon's
A third provider, Mossgate Systems, said it is "reviewing" its price list
events.argument: On Monday the cut looked like a pass-through of lower costs. A rival with an older fleet matching in two days, and undercutting by a token amount, suggests share is the real target. The provider with the lowest serving cost can sustain this longest; the others are now choosing between margin and customers.
counterpoints: List prices matter less than committed-use discounts, which neither company disclosed
A price war for inference can still grow total spend if usage is elastic enough

sources.title: Cinderpeak Compute cuts inference prices to match rival

events.title: Tallowmere Robotics files for an IPO
events.takeaway: The filing shows real revenue and a real customer concentration problem.
data_points: Top two customers account for 47% of revenue
Order backlog $1.3bn, of which 70% is deliverable after 2026
events.argument: Growth and backlog are strong enough to list on. The concentration is the story: losing either of the top two customers would erase a year of growth, and both are building in-house teams.
counterpoints: Backlog definitions in the filing include non-binding letters of intent

events.title: Vellmark two-year yield falls 14bp after the hold
events.takeaway: Bond markets took the dropped tightening bias at face value and now price a cut by June.
events.what_changed: The two-year yield fell 14bp to 3.71%; swaps now imply a 70% chance of a cut by June, up from 35%.
data_points: Two-year yield 3.71%, the lowest since October
Currency down 0.8% against its trade-weighted basket
counterpoints: One member who voted to hold said in an interview that June is "too early to discuss"

sources.title: Vellmark short-dated yields drop as markets price June cut

events.title: Northwind capex: two brokers question the return on packaging spend
events.takeaway: The first organised pushback: the spend is real, the payback period is the debate.
events.what_changed: Two brokers cut their ratings, estimating a payback period of 6.5 years on the packaging lines against management's 4.
data_points: Estimated payback 6.5 years versus 4 years guided
Free cash flow margin forecast for 2026 cut from 21% to 16%
